title: Update nl80211 constants, nl80211 constants generation tool URL
description:
Update nl80211 constants after modifying upstream latest constants URL used in generation tool.

Persistent and annoying web scrapers caused kernel.org to move to proof of work to access,
which causes simple Python requests library to fail with HTTP error code 403, access forbidden.
Changing to GitHub URL works okay.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 69610fee - Update nl80211 generation tool with latest enums
  • fc685185 - nl80211: Update nl80211 consts to latest
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22397/diffs?diff_id=1573685958&start_sha=5719dafd882431beac69dc9196b05be20d96f93f)
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

commits_data.title: Update nl80211 generation tool source URL
commits_data.message:
Update nl80211 generation tool source URL

With recent changes to the kernel.org to combat burdensome
AI web scrapers [1], grabbing latest nl80211.h constants
from the existing URL generates a HTTP 403 URL forbidden
error. Switch to GitHub mirror which does not generate same
error.

[1] https://social.kernel.org/notice/Asir7LiPevX6XcEVJQ
